BiblicalUsage: Serach is the excess, the overhanging part — the half curtain left over from the coverings of the tabernacle, which was to hang over the back of it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even the leftover curtain had its place, because in God's house nothing is wasted.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
